name: Hinglish / Code-switched
notes: Captions must be written exactly as spoken: 'yaar ye kaam nahi karega' stays Roman, do not convert it to Devanagari.
Set the font stack as: Devanagari face first, then a Latin face, so mixed lines do not jump in size.
word_timings must come from whisper large-v3 with language=hi; code-switched audio is mis-timed by small models.
English technical words stay in English. Never translate a product name.
